rules.roads: Natural Earth 1:10m roads in India, sampled every 4 km and snapped to hex-centre links. Class 0 (freeway): every road Natural Earth marks as a major highway (expressway). Class 1 (main road): other roads at Natural Earth scale rank 6 or less, where no freeway already joins the same two hexes.
rules.rail: Natural Earth 1:10m railroads at scale rank 9 or less, sampled every 4 km and snapped to hex-centre links; tier 0 (main line) is scale rank 6 or less. Natural Earth railways are map art: older alignments, no traffic data, and recent lines may be missing.
rules.ports: Every Natural Earth 1:10m port on India's coasts (Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, Indian Ocean), ranked by Natural Earth's scale rank (lower = more prominent). No tonnage is available.
rules.airports: Every OurAirports large or medium airport in India with scheduled passenger service. No passenger counts are available.
